info.title: Looply API
info.description: Core and Auth/User Backend contract. End-to-end product completion is tracked in docs/requirements/FUNCTIONAL_REQUIREMENTS.md.

200.description: HTTP process is running; this endpoint does not query the database.

post.summary: Request a purpose-bound OTP. Protected purposes require a bearer session. Unknown recovery/login accounts return the same accepted shape.
post.description: LOGIN_PHONE and RESET_PASSWORD challenges are also bound to the verified account that owned the contact when issued. A change of owner invalidates their use for the new account. No User ID is accepted from the client.

password.description: Verification input; new passwords must satisfy the separate 8-128 code point policy. The runtime bounds this field to 512 UTF-16 code units.

Reauthenticate.description: Exactly one usable method: password, verified-phone code plus challengeId, or linked Google credential plus challengeId. Invalid method combinations are rejected with 401.
